about: recipe.toml texts, each valid (with what it names) or refused with the rule it breaks; expressions and their arrays are crates/rvr-recipe/tests/fixtures/recipe.json and properties.json; see README.md

cases.rule: the example atlas_higgs_4lep
cases.text:
# A selection after ATLAS's H → ZZ* → 4ℓ open-data analysis: exactly four leptons, of total
# charge zero, two or four of each flavour (lep_type is 11 for an electron and 13 for a muon, so
# the sum is 44, 48 or 52; as in ATLAS's notebook, the charge of each flavour is not checked). The four-lepton mass is in GeV, the leptons taken as massless. The
# weight scales each simulated event to the data's luminosity; the files carry every factor it
# needs, the sum of weights included, so [totals] has nothing to add.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "H → ZZ* → 4ℓ"

[define]
scale_factors = "scaleFactor_PILEUP * scaleFactor_ELE * scaleFactor_MUON * scaleFactor_LepTRIGGER"

[keep]
four_leptons = "lep_n == 4"
zero_charge = "sum(lep_charge) == 0"
same_flavour_pairs = "sum(lep_type) in [44, 48, 52]"

[columns]
branches = ["lep_pt", "lep_eta", "lep_phi", "lep_type", "met_et"]
m4l = "mass(lep_pt, lep_eta, lep_phi) / 1000"
weight = "if(sample.kind == 'data', 0 * met_et + 1, mcWeight * scale_factors * XSection * 1000 * sample.lumi / SumWeights)"

[totals]

# Worked out from the stored leptons when it is read: the four-lepton system's pt, in GeV.
[derived]
pt4l = "pt(lep_pt, lep_eta, lep_phi) / 1000"

cases.rule: the example dimuon_spectrum
cases.text:
# Events with exactly two muons of opposite charge, and the mass of the pair. Plotted on a log scale
# from 0.25 to 300 GeV, it shows the resonances from the eta to the Z.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "Dimuon mass spectrum"

[define]

[keep]
two_muons = "nMuon == 2"
opposite_charge = "sum(Muon_charge) == 0"

[columns]
branches = ["Muon_pt", "Muon_eta"]
mass = "first(pair_mass(Muon_pt, Muon_eta, Muon_phi, Muon_mass), -1)"

[totals]

# The mass on a log scale, as the spectrum is drawn, worked out when it is read.
[derived]
log_mass = "log(mass)"

cases.rule: the example higgs_tautau
cases.text:
# A muon and a hadronic tau of opposite charge, the selection of the CMS Open Data H → ττ study,
# with the pair's visible mass and the muon's transverse mass. Only branches every sample has are
# used: the data have no GenPart.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "H → ττ, muon and tau"

[define]
good_muon = "Muon_tightId and Muon_pfRelIso04_all < 0.1 and Muon_pt > 17 and abs(Muon_eta) < 2.1"
good_tau = "Tau_idDecayMode and Tau_idIsoTight and Tau_idAntiEleTight and Tau_idAntiMuTight and Tau_pt > 20 and abs(Tau_eta) < 2.3"
# The leading good muon (mu1) and good tau (tau1).
mu1_pt = "first(Muon_pt[good_muon], 0)"
mu1_eta = "first(Muon_eta[good_muon], 0)"
mu1_phi = "first(Muon_phi[good_muon], 0)"
mu1_charge = "first(Muon_charge[good_muon], 0)"
tau1_pt = "first(Tau_pt[good_tau], 0)"
tau1_eta = "first(Tau_eta[good_tau], 0)"
tau1_phi = "first(Tau_phi[good_tau], 0)"
tau1_charge = "first(Tau_charge[good_tau], 0)"

[keep]
trigger = "HLT_IsoMu17_eta2p1_LooseIsoPFTau20"
a_good_muon = "count(good_muon) >= 1"
a_good_tau = "count(good_tau) >= 1"
opposite_charge = "mu1_charge * tau1_charge < 0"

[columns]
branches = ["run", "luminosityBlock", "event", "PV_npvs", "MET_pt", "MET_phi", "Jet_pt"]
mu_pt = "mu1_pt"
tau_pt = "tau1_pt"
visible_mass = "sqrt(2 * mu1_pt * tau1_pt * (cosh(mu1_eta - tau1_eta) - cos(delta_phi(mu1_phi, tau1_phi))))"
mt = "sqrt(2 * mu1_pt * MET_pt * (1 - cos(delta_phi(mu1_phi, MET_phi))))"

[totals]

# Worked out from the stored jets when it is read; the file keeps only the expression.
[derived]
ht = "sum(Jet_pt)"

cases.rule: the example lhcb_b_to_kkk
cases.text:
# B± → K± K+ K−: three tracks that are kaons, not pions or muons, and the B's mass from their
# momenta (MeV), each track given the kaon's mass. B_charge tells B+ from B−, for the CP asymmetry.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "B± → K± K+ K−"

# Each track's energy if it is a kaon (493.677 MeV), and the three tracks' momentum together.
[define]
e1 = "sqrt(H1_PX ** 2 + H1_PY ** 2 + H1_PZ ** 2 + 493.677 ** 2)"
e2 = "sqrt(H2_PX ** 2 + H2_PY ** 2 + H2_PZ ** 2 + 493.677 ** 2)"
e3 = "sqrt(H3_PX ** 2 + H3_PY ** 2 + H3_PZ ** 2 + 493.677 ** 2)"
px = "H1_PX + H2_PX + H3_PX"
py = "H1_PY + H2_PY + H3_PY"
pz = "H1_PZ + H2_PZ + H3_PZ"

[keep]
no_muons = "H1_isMuon == 0 and H2_isMuon == 0 and H3_isMuon == 0"
kaons = "H1_ProbK > 0.5 and H2_ProbK > 0.5 and H3_ProbK > 0.5"
not_pions = "H1_ProbPi < 0.5 and H2_ProbPi < 0.5 and H3_ProbPi < 0.5"

[columns]
branches = ["B_FlightDistance", "B_VertexChi2"]
B_mass = "sqrt((e1 + e2 + e3) ** 2 - px ** 2 - py ** 2 - pz ** 2)"
B_charge = "H1_Charge + H2_Charge + H3_Charge"

[totals]

# Whether a candidate is within 50 MeV of the B mass, worked out when it is read.
[derived]
in_b_window = "abs(B_mass - 5279.3) < 50"

names.title: A tour of the recipe language

cases.rule: the example recipe_tour
cases.text:
# Every table of a recipe, and most kinds of function, in one study. The recipe reference
# (crates/rvr-recipe/README.md) explains each.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "A tour of the recipe language"

# Names for expressions, used by the lines below them; a name may use the names above it.
[define]
good_muon = "Muon_tightId and Muon_pfRelIso04_all < 0.15 and Muon_pt > 20 and abs(Muon_eta) < 2.1"
good_tau = "Tau_idDecayMode and Tau_idIsoTight and Tau_idAntiMuTight and Tau_pt > 20 and abs(Tau_eta) < 2.3"
# Jets above 30 GeV, ΔR > 0.4 away from every good muon and good tau.
clean_jet = "Jet_pt > 30 and abs(Jet_eta) < 4.7 and dr_nearest(Jet_eta, Jet_phi, Muon_eta[good_muon], Muon_phi[good_muon]) > 0.4 and dr_nearest(Jet_eta, Jet_phi, Tau_eta[good_tau], Tau_phi[good_tau]) > 0.4"
opposite = "first(Muon_charge[good_muon], 0) * first(Tau_charge[good_tau], 0) < 0"

# The cuts, in order. Each sample's metadata names its trigger's branch; the last cut applies to
# the VBF sample alone, and the other passes it.
[keep]
trigger = "branch(sample.trigger)"
a_muon_and_a_tau = "count(good_muon) >= 1 and count(good_tau) >= 1"
opposite_charge = "opposite"
two_jets_in_vbf = { if = "sample.production == 'vbf'", apply = "count(clean_jet) >= 2" }

# Branches stored as they are, one under a new name, and columns computed while pressing: flat
# and jagged, and one stored as a smaller type.
[columns]
branches = ["run", "event", "MET_pt", "MET_phi"]
npv = "PV_npvs"
n_clean_jets = { value = "count(clean_jet)", stored = "u1" }
clean_jet_pt = "Jet_pt[clean_jet]"
leading_jet_pt = "nth(sorted(Jet_pt[clean_jet], 'descending'), 0, -1)"
jet_eta_by_pt = "take(Jet_eta[clean_jet], order(Jet_pt[clean_jet], 'descending'), -9)"
max_mjj = "greatest(pair_mass(Jet_pt[clean_jet], Jet_eta[clean_jet], Jet_phi[clean_jet], Jet_mass[clean_jet]), -1)"
dr_mu_tau = "delta_r(first(Muon_eta[good_muon], 0), first(Muon_phi[good_muon], 0), first(Tau_eta[good_tau], 0), first(Tau_phi[good_tau], 0))"
b_tagged = "count(Jet_btag[clean_jet] > 0.8)"
tau_decay_mode = "first(Tau_decayMode[good_tau], -1)"

[totals]

# Columns kept as their expressions over the stored columns, worked out when they are read: flat,
# a list, and one that reads the sample's metadata.
[derived]
met_over_leading_jet = "MET_pt / max(leading_jet_pt, 1)"
clean_jet_pt_over_met = "clean_jet_pt / MET_pt"
vbf_scaled_met = "MET_pt * if(sample.production == 'vbf', 2, 1)"

cases.rule: the example zmumu
cases.text:
# Two muons of opposite charge, the pair's mass and pt, and a weight per event that scales each
# simulated sample to the data's luminosity. The data file holds only muons, so nothing else is read.
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1

[define]
good_muon = "Muon_pt > 20 and abs(Muon_eta) < 2.4"

[keep]
two_muons = "count(good_muon) == 2"
opposite_charge = "sum(Muon_charge[good_muon]) == 0"

[columns]
branches = ["nMuon", "Muon_pt"]
mass = "first(pair_mass(Muon_pt[good_muon], Muon_eta[good_muon], Muon_phi[good_muon], Muon_mass[good_muon]), -1)"
pt = "first(pair_pt(Muon_pt[good_muon], Muon_eta[good_muon], Muon_phi[good_muon], Muon_mass[good_muon]), -1)"

# Every simulated event of these files weighs 1, so the sum of the weights is the number read.
[totals]
sumw = "1"

# Worked out from what the file holds when it is read.
[derived]
leading_muon_pt = "first(Muon_pt, -1)"
weight = "if(sample.kind == 'data', 1.0, sample.xsec * 1000 * sample.lumi / sample.sumw)"

cases.rule: every table, totals over another tree, stored kinds, a cut for some samples
cases.text:
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
title = "t"
[define]
good = "Jet_pt > 30"
[keep]
hem = { if = "sample.era == 3", apply = "count(good) >= 1" }
[columns]
branches = ["MET_pt"]
w = { value = "genWeight", stored = "f4" }
[totals]
sumw = "genWeight"
runs = { value = "genEventSumw", tree = "Runs" }
[derived]
r = "w / sample.sumw"

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: format required
rust_says: A recipe starts with format = "rvr-recipe" and version = 1

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: format is rvr-recipe
rust_says: A recipe starts with format = "rvr-recipe" and version = 1

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: version is 1
rust_says: A recipe starts with format = "rvr-recipe" and version = 1

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: no other top key
rust_says: A recipe has no key "select"; it takes format, version, title, chunk_rows, define, keep, columns, totals, derived.

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: title is text
rust_says: title must be text, as title = "my study"

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: every table written
rust_says: A recipe has no [totals] table: every recipe has its five tables, [define], [keep], [columns], [totals] and [derived], each written even when it is empty. Add the line [totals].

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: [columns] stores a column
rust_says: The recipe stores nothing: under [columns], list branches (branches = ["MET_pt"]) or name computed columns (ht = "sum(Jet_pt)")

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: a cut has apply
rust_says: [keep] met needs apply = "…": the cut, for the samples its if is true for

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: a cut has no other key
rust_says: [keep] met has no key "when"; it takes if, apply.
cases.text:
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
[keep]
met = { apply = "MET_pt > 0", when = "x" }

[define]

[columns]
branches = ["MET_pt"]

[totals]

[derived]

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: stored is a kind
rust_says: [columns] x stored: "f2" is not a number kind: the kinds are b1, i1, i2, i4, i8, u1, u2, u4, u8, f4, f8. Did you mean: f4, f8, i2?

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: a total's tree is nonempty
rust_says: [totals] t tree must name a tree of each file, such as "Runs"
cases.text:
format = "rvr-recipe"
version = 1
[totals]
t = { value = "MET_pt", tree = "" }

[define]

[keep]

[columns]
branches = ["MET_pt"]

[derived]

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: a plain name
rust_says: [columns] two words: a column is named with one plain name, such as ht, and not sample, entry or file

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: no word of the language
rust_says: [columns] and: a column is named with one plain name, such as ht, and not sample, entry or file

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: no column named entry
rust_says: [columns] entry: a column is named with one plain name, such as ht, and not sample, entry or file

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: no total named events_read
rust_says: [totals] events_read: a total is named with one plain name, such as sumw, and not sample, entry, file, events_read, events_total, events_missing

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: no two columns alike
rust_says: Two columns are named MET_pt: give one another name

cases.rule: RECIPE the-keys-exactly: a defined name uses those above it
rust_says: [define] a uses b, which is defined below it: a defined name may use only the names defined above it

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: syntax
rust_says: [columns] x: Expected a value at the end (column 9)

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: a function's values
rust_says: [columns] x: count takes 1 value, not 2

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: a function that does not exist
rust_says: [columns] x: There is no function named cuont. Did you mean: count? Every function, with an example, is in the recipe reference: https://gitlab.cern.ch/dgrove/rowver/-/blob/main/crates/rvr-recipe/README.md

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: a dot after a name
rust_says: [columns] x: Only sample has a field after a dot, as in sample.era (the dot at column 4). Name a branch in full, such as Jet_pt, and keep some members of it with a mask, such as Jet_pt[good_jet]; a branch whose name holds a dot is written branch('Jet.pt')

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: not of a number, as far as the text tells
rust_says: [keep] c: not needs a true-or-false value, not a number: to test a number, compare it, as x != 0

cases.rule: RECIPE mistakes: and of numbers, as far as the text tells
rust_says: [columns] x: and's left side needs a true-or-false value, not a number: to test a number, compare it, as x != 0
[columns] x: and's right side needs a true-or-false value, not a number: to test a number, compare it, as x != 0

cases.rule: RECIPE operators: comparisons do not chain
rust_says: [keep] c: Comparisons do not chain (the second at column 12): write a < b and b < c, not a < b < c

cases.rule: RECIPE how-deep: 100 levels at most
rust_says: [columns] x: The expression is more than 100 levels deep at column 101 (a defined name as deep as its own expression): write it with fewer

cases.rule: RECIPE the-parts-of-a-recipe: a derived column uses only stored columns and those above it
rust_says: [derived] a uses b, but b is a derived column below it: a derived column uses only the columns the file stores, under [columns], and the derived columns above it
